description: Round a list of prices to price points that end in .99 or .95, or to the nearest 5 cents, under the rule and direction you choose. Send prices (up to 200, each a price and an optional item code), rule (ends_99, ends_95 or nearest_5_cents) and direction (nearest, up or down; default nearest). Get back each price rounded, the change per item (rounded minus original, in cents and dollars), a status that says why a price was left alone, and the totals before and after with the total change. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/price-rounding-rules). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

direction.description: nearest (default; an exact halfway price goes up), up (never lowers a price), or down (never raises one).

label.description: Optional label for the price list (your own text, echoed back).

prices.description: The prices to round, up to 200.

price.description: Price in your currency's major unit, up to 2 decimals, for example 12.34.

rule.description: ends_99: price points 0.99, 1.99, 2.99 ...; ends_95: 0.95, 1.95 ...; nearest_5_cents: every multiple of 0.05.

name: price_rounding_rules
title: Price Rounding Rules (.99, .95, 5 Cents)
